questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive the speed limit with caution.

questions.explanation: Slow down when it rains, snows, or sleets. These conditions make roads slippery. You may need to drive slower than the speed limit for safety.

questions.question: To turn left from a multilane, one-way street or highway, start from:
questions.explanation: Start from the left lane when turning left from multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working. You should:

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: Without power steering, you need to steer harder. Reduce your speed and pull off the road to a safe place to stop.

questions.question: Your wheels drop onto the shoulder. You should:

options.text: Brake hard and turn sharply back onto the road.
Stop your car on the edge of the road.
Slow down and carefully turn back onto the road.
Keep your speed and turn sharply back onto the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and carefully turn back onto the road.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed without braking and carefully turn back onto the road. Watch for other traffic as you return to the road.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, you should signal:

options.text: Early enough so others know your plans.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so others know your plans.
questions.explanation: Signal early before passing so other drivers have time to see your plans.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: If a train is close or moving fast enough to be dangerous, you must:

options.text: Not cross the tracks until the train passes completely.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find another route across the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not cross the tracks until the train passes completely.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing. Do not cross if a train is close or moving fast. This is true even if there are no signals or they are broken.

questions.question: Stopping distance does not depend on:
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road condition, and speed. Time of day does not affect it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. It means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What can help you sober up after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: There is no quick way to sober up. A cold shower, black coffee, exercising, or eating may make you feel more alert, but these do not speed up how fast alcohol leaves your body.

questions.question: Turning your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes, leaving a curb, or merging into traffic is:

options.text: Not necessary if you use the rearview mirror.

questions.explanation: When changing lanes, check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: What helps drivers save gasoline?

options.text: Running the car while sitting in the driveway.

questions.explanation: Quick stops waste fuel because you must accelerate again to reach normal speed. If you look ahead and slow down gradually, you can avoid unnecessary braking and use less gas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn at this location.

questions.question: To be ready for anything on the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Continually look at the entire road and both sides.
Stare straight ahead at all times.
Keep your left foot on the brake pedal.
Focus only on the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continually look at the entire road and both sides.
questions.explanation: Safe driving depends on spotting problems before you reach them. Look far ahead and scan the entire road, including both sides. Do not just stare at the center.

questions.question: A driver can legally pass on the right side of another vehicle:

options.text: If the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
Even if it means driving off the pavement.

questions.correctAnswerText: If the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right if there is a passing lane and the other vehicle is turning left or waiting to turn left. You may also pass on the right on a multilane road with lanes going the same direction. Never drive off the road to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: What does an orange sign mean?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs with black symbols warn about construction, maintenance, or emergency work.

questions.question: How can you help prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Release the gas pedal and let your vehicle slow before braking.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops make it hard for drivers behind you to stop. Release the gas to slow down, then apply steady brake pressure. This activates your brake lights and stops smoothly.

questions.question: You must use extra caution when driving near a pedestrian with a white cane because:

options.text: He or she is a police officer.
He or she has poor balance.

questions.explanation: A white cane means the person is blind. Slow down, yield the right-of-way, and be ready to stop to keep them safe.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Activate your turn signal 3 to 4 seconds before turning.

questions.question: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options.text: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use the same full lane width as all other vehicles.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block traffic flow. You can get a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When driving behind a motorcycle, what is the minimum following distance?
questions.explanation: Keep at least four seconds between your car and a motorcycle. If the motorcycle falls, you need extra distance to stop and avoid hitting it.

questions.question: Fog reduces visibility of other vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signals. When driving in fog, what should you do?

options.text: Do not use your high beam headlights
Use low beam headlights to see the road better

questions.explanation: In fog, drive slowly and carefully. Do not use high beam headlights. Use low beams instead—they light up the road and objects better in fog.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic going in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.
